production_rules: The approved SVG master template is immutable for a layout version.
Each run may replace only approved placeholder values: date, KPI values, employee names, attendance times, durations, status colors/text, chart bars and percentages.
Header artwork, office background, card geometry, typography, spacing, chart containers, table geometry and footer are fixed in the master template.
The renderer verifies the Git blob SHA of the master template before rendering. A background/layout edit without a version change blocks publication.
Render exactly one 1080x1440 PNG per report.
Teams sends exactly that PNG through native hostedContent and may only scale it proportionally.
All attendance values come only from the canonical business report; missing values are never inferred.
